_doc: RADE manifest (contract: rhope-ops/RADE schemas/rade-manifest.schema.json). Built by the RADE engine through scripts/build_paste_bundles.py (a pinned shim, see scripts/rade.lock.json). Each bundle is one round: a self-contained PowerShell text the PFM copies from its raw page and pastes into Windows PowerShell ISE (F5). It writes the files, then opens RADE, the Redacted Application Deployment Engine (a window; text prompts if no window can open): steps run one by one with a live log and PASS/FAIL counts, then one results folder (Rounds\\<round>: a report file plus copies of the PDFs, to attach to one e-mail; zips do not cross the boundary) and a summary for the clipboard. It runs only the steps inside it (PFM 3A). A step's "default" may be {passed, paths}: the step is ticked only when those files changed since the round that passed it; after a round passes it, set passed to the new hash (PFM 14 Nov 26). Never hand-edit scripts/gov/paste/*.ps1: change this file or the sources and rebuild. A step may list "needs" (check ids in the engine's $checkDefs) and "estimate" (minutes, used until a real run time exists). "apps" is the embedded catalog the Choose screen lists (name, plain-English summary, step names); without it, one application has every step. A guide step may set "doneText" (its Done button) and "doneLog" (the log line on Done).

bundles.title: Round R27 r1: the flows read 6 values from PFM Settings, test e-mails without [TEST], a second person in Visitors (T4), 3 look probes, the health flow and a tiny app file

steps.name: T18 Import the slice flows r6
steps.note: You import the new 90-161.Z flows (F03 r6, F05 r3, F06 r2). They now read 6 values from the list PFM Settings, and test e-mails have no [TEST] in the subject. About 8 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. On this RADE card, select "Open in browser".
2. If Power Automate asks you to sign in: sign in with your CAC.
3. On the left, select Solutions (it can be under More).
4. Select "Import solution".
5. Select Browse.
6. Select the box "File name".
7. In the box "File name", press Ctrl+V (the file path is on the clipboard).
8. Select Open.
9. Select Next.
10. If the page says the solution already exists: select Upgrade.
11. If the page shows connection boxes: in each box, select your existing connection.
12. Select Next.
13. If the box "1 Site URL" is empty: type the test site address (RADE shows it in its box "Site address").
14. If the box "2 Alert e-mail" is empty: type your own work e-mail address.
There is no box for Test mode any more: the test step writes Test mode Yes into the list PFM Settings.
15. Select Import.
16. Wait for the line "Successfully imported" (1 to 3 minutes, estimate).
17. Select the solution "90-161.Z flows".
18. Look at the Status column: F05 and F06 must read On, and F03 must read Off.
19. If one of them differs: select that flow.
20. If you selected a flow: select "Turn on" for F05 or F06, or "Turn off" for F03.
21. Return to the RADE window.
22. Select "Done: imported".
If the import fails: select "Download log file", then select "It failed" and type the first red error line (no names).
steps.help: Send the results as they are; the import log step reads the log if you downloaded it.

makes.name: 90-161.Z flows (F03 r6, F05 r3, F06 r2; upgrade)

steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Automate US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/us-govt): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, PFM to confirm in R13)

steps.name: T17 Import log reader r2
steps.note: Runs only if an import failed: copies the error rows of an import log saved in the last 3 hours to T17, addresses masked. Otherwise it reports SKIPPED.

steps.name: T18 Slice test, part 1 r5
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Writes the PFM Settings rows the flows read (Test mode Yes) and the stage 6 target of 25 working days. Makes 3 fake publications at step 6 and checks F05.
after: T18 Import the slice flows r6
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A FAIL here is a finding about the Settings rows or the flows.

steps.name: T18 Failure e-mail and Resubmit r2
steps.note: You check that F05 e-mailed you about a planned test failure, and you select Resubmit on that failed run. About 4 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. Open Outlook (the program on your computer).
2. Select the folder Inbox.
3. Find the e-mail "90-161.Z flow failed: F05" from the last few minutes (it is a planned test failure; do not reply).
4. Return to the RADE window.
5. On this RADE card, select "Open in browser".
6. On the left, select Solutions (it can be under More).
7. Select the solution "90-161.Z flows".
8. Select the flow "90161Z F05 Endorsement Routing r3".
9. Under "28-day run history", select the run marked Failed.
10. At the top of the run, select Resubmit.
11. Wait until the new run reads Succeeded (under 1 minute, estimate).
12. Return to the RADE window.
13. Select "Done: resubmitted".
If no failure e-mail arrived, or there is no failed run: select "It failed" and type what you see (no names or site address).

answers.prompt: When did the failure e-mail reach your Inbox?

steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Automate US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/us-govt): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, PFM to confirm in R13)

steps.name: T18 Run F03 once r6
steps.note: You run F03 once by hand. Test mode is Yes in the list PFM Settings, so its e-mails go only to you. About 3 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. On this RADE card, select "Open in browser".
2. On the left, select Solutions (it can be under More).
3. Select the solution "90-161.Z flows".
4. Select the flow "90161Z F03 Suspense Reminders r6".
5. At the top, select Test.
6. Select Manually.
7. Select Test.
8. Select "Run flow".
9. Select Done.
10. Wait until the run ends (under 1 minute, estimate).
11. Read the status at the top of the run: Succeeded or Failed. Grey (skipped) steps are normal.
12. Write down the time on your computer clock. The e-mail step later asks how long the e-mail took.
13. Return to the RADE window.
14. If the status is Succeeded: select "Done: F03 ran".
If the status is Failed: select "It failed" and type the name of the first step with a red mark and the first line of its error (no names or site address).
after: T18 Failure e-mail and Resubmit r2
steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Automate US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/us-govt): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, PFM to confirm in R13)

steps.name: T18 Slice test, part 2 r5
steps.note: Checks: no duplicates after Resubmit; F03 read the Settings row; one escalation; no [TEST] in titles; F06 hold, resume, cancel; Legal rows. Puts Settings back, removes test rows.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The test rows stay on the site for review when a check fails.

steps.name: T18 Find the test e-mails r2
steps.note: You look for the F03 test e-mails, which now have no [TEST] in the subject, and answer 2 questions. About 2 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. Open Outlook (the program on your computer).
2. Select the folder Inbox.
3. In the search box at the top, type: Escalation: coordination response due
4. Press Enter.
5. Look for an e-mail received today, after the time you wrote down at the F03 run.
6. If it is not in the Inbox: select the folder "Junk Email".
7. If it is not in the Inbox: look for the same subject there.
8. Return to the RADE window.
9. Select "Done: I looked".
If Outlook does not open: select "It failed" and type what you see (no names or addresses).

answers.prompt: Where is the F03 e-mail "Escalation: coordination response due ..." from this round?
How many minutes after the F03 run did it arrive? Type a number, or 0 if not found.

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: looked for the e-mails.

steps.name: T23 Make the app file r1
steps.note: Makes one tiny Power Apps app file (one screen with the text "90-161.Z test app") in the T23 folder and puts its path on the clipboard. No sign-in.
steps.help: Send the results as they are.

steps.name: T23 Upload the app file r1
steps.note: You try to open a tiny app file that was built outside Power Apps, in 2 places in Power Apps. A refusal is the expected result and a valid answer. Nothing is saved. About 5 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. On this RADE card, select "Open in browser".
2. If Power Apps asks you to sign in: sign in with your CAC.
3. On the left, select Create.
4. Select "Blank app".
5. Under "Blank canvas app", select Create.
6. In the box "App name", type: 90161Z T23 test
7. Select Create. The app editor opens.
8. On the left, select Insert (the plus sign).
9. At the bottom of the Insert pane, select "Get more components".
10. Select Import component, or the Upload or Import button that the panel shows.
11. Select the box "File name".
12. In the box "File name", press Ctrl+V (the file path is on the clipboard).
13. Select Open.
14. Write down what the panel says.
15. Close the panel.
16. At the top left, select the back arrow or File.
17. Select Open.
18. Select Browse (or "Browse files").
19. In the box "File name", press Ctrl+V.
20. Select Open.
21. Look at the editor: a screen with the text "90-161.Z test app", or an error.
22. Close the app editor tab. If it asks to save: select "Don't save".
23. Return to the RADE window.
24. Select "Done: tried".
If Power Apps does not open: select "It failed" and type what you see (no names or site address).
after: T23 Make the app file r1

answers.prompt: Get more components, import: what happened?
If there was an error, type its first line (no names or site address). Else type none.

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: tried the app file.
steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Apps US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/powerapps-us-government): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value)

steps.name: T21 Make the probe list r3
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Makes the fake probe list (Visitors get Contribute on this list only) and library, uploads one fake workbook and writes the test page.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A second run changes nothing.

steps.name: T21 Import the probe solution r3
steps.note: You import the solution "90-161.Z probe" (2 flows: health and button) and answer 2 questions. About 8 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. On this RADE card, select "Open in browser".
2. If Power Automate asks you to sign in: sign in with your CAC.
3. On the left, select Solutions (it can be under More).
4. Select "Import solution".
5. Select Browse.
6. Select the box "File name".
7. In the box "File name", press Ctrl+V (the file path is on the clipboard).
8. Select Open.
9. Select Next.
10. Look at the connection boxes: there should be one for SharePoint and one for "Power Automate Management".
11. In each connection box, select the arrow.
12. In each list that opens, select your existing connection.
13. If a box has no connection: select "New connection" in that box.
14. If you selected "New connection": select Create.
15. If a sign-in window opens: sign in with your CAC.
16. If you made a new connection: return to the browser tab where you started the import.
17. If you made a new connection: select Refresh.
18. Select Next.
19. In the box "1 Site URL", type the test site address (RADE shows it in its box "Site address").
20. Select Import.
21. Wait for the line "Successfully imported" (1 to 3 minutes, estimate).
22. Select the solution "90-161.Z probe".
23. Look at the Status column: the 2 flows "90161Z T21 Probe ..." must read On.
24. If a flow reads Off: select that flow.
25. If you selected a flow that reads Off: select "Turn on".
26. Return to the RADE window.
27. Select "Done: imported".
If the import fails: select "Download log file", then select "It failed" and type the first red error line (no names).
after: T21 Make the probe list r3

answers.prompt: Did the import page show a connection box for "Power Automate Management"?
choices: Yes, and I selected a connection
Yes, but no connection could be made

answers.prompt: Did any page say a Premium licence is needed?

steps.help: Send the results as they are; the import log step reads the log if you downloaded it.
steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Automate US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/us-govt): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, PFM to confirm in R13)

steps.name: T21 Open the test page r3
steps.note: Opens the test page in your browser (no sign-in). Keep its tab open: the next steps use it.
steps.help: Send the results as they are.
after: T21 Make the probe list r3

steps.name: T21 Start the health flow r3
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Adds one fake row that starts the health flow: it reads your own flows and their last runs, counts only.
steps.help: Send the results as they are.
after: T21 Import the probe solution r3

steps.name: T21 Add the second person r3
steps.note: A small window asks for the e-mail address of the second person. It stays on this computer. Adds that person to the site's Visitors group and copies the form link.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The address is never written to a file; the results show only yes or no.
after: T21 Make the probe list r3

steps.name: T21 Second person r3
steps.note: Test T4 again. The person you added to Visitors adds one row with the form link. About 5 minutes (estimate). If nobody is free today, select Skip.
guide: 1. Open Teams.
2. Select Chat.
3. Start a chat with the person whose address you typed.
4. Select the chat box.
5. In the chat box, press Ctrl+V (the form link is on the clipboard).
6. In the chat box, type: Please open this link, type T4a in Title, select Save, and tell me what you saw.
7. Press Enter.
8. Wait for the answer of the person in the chat: the row saved, or no permission.
9. Return to the RADE window.
10. Select "Done: second person".
If nothing was pasted: select Skip. If nobody is free today: select Skip.
after: T21 Add the second person r3

answers.prompt: What did the second person see?

steps.name: T21 Format the form and view r3
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Puts a test header on the probe list form and makes a list view with a button that starts the test flow. Reads both back.
steps.help: Send the results as they are.
after: T21 Import the probe solution r3

steps.name: T21 Look at the list form r3
steps.note: You look at the probe list form: does the test header show, and does its menu have "Configure layout". About 3 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. In the browser, select the tab "90-161.Z test page".
2. Select "Open the new row form".
3. Look at the top of the form for the text "90-161.Z test header".
4. At the top of the form, select the pencil or "Edit form" icon.
5. Look at the menu that opened for "Configure layout".
6. Select Cancel.
7. Return to the RADE window.
8. Select "Done: I looked".
after: T21 Format the form and view r3

answers.prompt: Did the form show the text "90-161.Z test header" at its top?
Does the form menu list "Configure layout"?

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: looked at the form.

steps.name: T21 Use the list button r3
steps.note: You select a button in a list view that starts a test flow for that row. About 4 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. In the browser, select the tab "90-161.Z test page".
2. Select "Open the list with the button".
3. Look at the first row for a button "Run the test flow".
4. In the first row, select "Run the test flow".
5. Look at the panel that opened for a button "Run".
6. Select "Run".
7. If the panel asks you to continue or to allow a connection: select "Continue".
8. Wait until the panel says the flow ran, or shows an error.
9. Return to the RADE window.
10. Select "Done: I clicked".
after: T21 Format the form and view r3

answers.prompt: What did the list show in each row?
choices: A button Run the test flow

answers.prompt: What did the panel say after you selected Run?

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: used the button.

steps.name: T21 Look at Excel in the browser r3
steps.note: You open a fake workbook in Excel for the web and look for an Automate tab. About 3 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. In the browser, select the tab "90-161.Z test page".
2. Select "Open the fake workbook".
3. Look at the tabs at the top of Excel for a tab named "Automate".
4. If there is an Automate tab: select it.
5. If you selected Automate: look whether its buttons can be selected or are grey.
6. Close the Excel tab.
7. Return to the RADE window.
8. Select "Done: I looked".
after: T21 Make the probe list r3

answers.prompt: Is there a tab named "Automate" in Excel for the web?
choices: Yes, with buttons I can select
Yes, but the buttons are grey

steps.doneLog: Confirmed by you: looked at Excel.

steps.name: T21 Read the test results r3
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Reads counts only: the health flow row, the rows by the second person (T4) and the button flow row. Waits up to 4 minutes for the health row.
steps.help: Send the results as they are.
after: T21 Start the health flow r3

steps.name: T21 Remove the probe list r3
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Removes the second person from Visitors again (only if this round added the person), and moves the probe list and library to the site Recycle Bin.
steps.help: Send the results as they are. Each removal runs even when an earlier one fails.
after: T21 Read the test results r3

steps.name: T21 Remove the probe solution r3
steps.note: You delete the solution "90-161.Z probe" that this round imported. About 3 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. On this RADE card, select "Open in browser".
2. On the left, select Solutions (it can be under More).
3. Select the three dots beside "90-161.Z probe".
4. Select "Delete from this environment".
5. Select Delete.
6. Return to the RADE window.
7. Select "Done: removed".
If the solution does not delete: select "It failed" and type the first line of the message.
after: T21 Remove the probe list r3
